findings.title: Journal page shows a malformed (non-list) response as 'No journal entries yet'
findings.expected: A bad response from the journal list shows a visible error, not an empty journal
findings.actual: When the response is {} the page shows '0 entries' and 'No journal entries yet', as if the garden had no entries
findings.evidence: {"text":["Journal","The latest notes from across the garden, newest first.","Write in a plant's journal","Search","0 entries","No journal entries yet","Open a plant and write the first entry in its journal.","Go to plants","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"],"alerts":["0 entries"]} | {"text":["Journal","The latest notes from across the garden, newest first.","Write in a plant's journal","Search","0 entries","No journal entries yet","Open a plant and write the first entry in its journal.","Go to plants","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"],"alerts":["0 entries"]}

findings.title: A search longer than 80 characters shows a raw validation error instead of results
findings.expected: The search box limits input to what the API accepts, or long searches are handled and show results or 'No entries match'
findings.actual: The search box has no maxlength, the API answers 422, and the page shows the alert 'Query.q: String should have at most 80 characters' with no results
findings.evidence: {"alerts":["Query.q: String should have at most 80 characters"],"text":["Journal","The latest notes from across the garden, newest first.","Write in a plant's journal","Search","Clear search","Query.q: String should have at most 80 characters","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"]} | {"alerts":["Query.q: String should have at most 80 characters"],"text":["Journal","The latest notes from across the garden, newest first.","Write in a plant's journal","Search","Clear search","Query.q: String should have at most 80 characters","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"]}

findings.title: Journal search stuck on 'Loading entries…' with stale 'No entries match' when the request hangs
findings.expected: A hung request times out and shows an error with a way to retry
findings.actual: After 13 s the page still shows 'Loading entries…' next to the previous search's 'No entries match' for the new term 'Tied', which does match an entry. No timeout and no error.
